column1: # Deterministic context signals and lexical classes
# Titles before a name (St. Louis): the period is not a sentence end.
# Lexical runs are bounded by script transitions and clause punctuation.
# Phrase evidence saturates below the default attached-particle signal.
# Predicate roles are deterministic policy data, not POS-model predictions.
# Universal quantity symbols inherit the neighboring numerical context.
# Explicit content labels select the following lexical run's speech language.
# A customer weight of 0 disables a label; labels are exact token spellings.
# Explicit content labels, same bounded lexical-run policy as title cues.
# Seed lexical classes, separate from target-language pronunciation data.
